dct_description_sm: A polygon geometry to represent the neighbourhoods of the City of Airdrie. Dataset was created by importing line work from Area Structure Plans, Neighbourhood Structure Plans and Subdivision Plan AutoCAD drawings from various consultants who support development projects in Airdrie. Boundary lines are often updated and geometrically corrected by comparison to our monthly subscription to registered land base information from AltaLIS and reviewing the Alberta Township Grid V 4.1 dimensions.
